critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:96-102,144-153 PublicUser model + user_public() now return picture (Optional[str]) and auth_provider (default 'email'). Google users get their picture URL + auth_provider='google' via /auth/session upsert (lines 236-248). Existing email-only user documents (created before iter_8) simply return picture=None + auth_provider='email' because .get() defaults are correct — no migration needed.

frontend/src/context/SettingsContext.tsx — Auto Mode prefs (autoMode/autoMinNet/autoTradeSize) are persisted to storage under key 'arbscout_prefs' together with existing prefs. DEFAULTS include autoRefreshSec=20, so freshly opened Scanner will refresh on 20s cadence as documented. save() spreads current prefs+patch so no field is dropped when toggling autoMode alone.

frontend/app/(tabs)/scanner.tsx:71-105 Auto-execute effect gates on autoMode + autoBusyRef + opps.length; computes estNet = size*(spread/100) - gas - (buyFee+sellFee)*size exactly as spec'd; sorts candidates desc by estNet and slices top 2 (max 2 per refresh cycle); tracks last exec per token_id in a Map with 90s COOLDOWN_MS. On 400 (insufficient balance) it breaks out early and shows 'Paused — insufficient balance' — good safety.

frontend/app/(tabs)/scanner.tsx:62 lastExecRef is a useRef Map — survives re-renders. autoBusyRef prevents double-fire when opps update mid-flight. refreshUser() is called (fire-and-forget) so dashboard balance updates after each auto trade — verified via UI (Balance moved from $10K → $10.09K).

frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:64-70 profile card correctly renders <Image source={{uri:user.picture}} /> only when user.picture is truthy; otherwise falls back to initials view with (display_name||email).slice(0,1). isGoogle switches ionicon + badge text; both branches wrapped in Text — no raw strings.

frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:283-299 SESSION section: row-session shows contextual label based on auth_provider, and logout-button lives INSIDE the SESSION section as spec'd (not floating). onLogout awaits auth logout THEN router.replace('/(auth)/login') — safe order.

Backend note: /api/trades/execute mode field is hardcoded 'SIMULATED' (server.py:481); auto-executed trades from Scanner therefore always land as SIMULATED in trades collection regardless of executionMode setting — matches the spec ('Never signs on-chain trades').
